title: GTA 6 Gameplay, Screenshots & South Park Cameo Revealed
description: Just three weeks away from the PS5 release, GTA 6 gets new gameplay, screenshots, and an unexpected cameo in South Park featuring hilarious dog poo mechanics.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 PS5 Launch Approaches with New Gameplay and a Wild South Park Cameo

With the PS5 launch of *GTA 6* now exactly three weeks away, anticipation has reached a fever pitch. According to reports from gaming media outlet Push Square, whether you have already made up your mind to play it on day one or are still on the fence, Rockstar Games is rolling out even more gameplay footage, screenshots, and detailed features to entice the community.

## A Surprising South Park Appearance

In a move that surprised millions, *GTA 6* recently made a brief appearance in an episode of the animated TV show *South Park*. In the broadcasted segment, a television presenter showcases actual gameplay from the upcoming title, highlighting a wonderfully chaotic open-world interaction: players can pick up dog waste and throw it at unsuspecting pedestrians passing by.

This kind of irreverent humor and emergent gameplay has always been a staple of the *Grand Theft Auto* franchise. Seeing it debut in such a mainstream animated series not only generated massive buzz but also gave fans a fresh, hilarious glimpse into the game's immersive sandbox environment.

## Getting Ready for Launch

Alongside unexpected media crossovers, Rockstar is ramping up information regarding release times and preload dates for the PS5 version. For those eagerly awaiting the arrival of the game, the final three-week countdown means preparation is key, with preload details helping fans get ready to dive straight into the action the moment it unlocks.

## Editor's Take

Rockstar's decision to tease actual *GTA 6* gameplay through *South Park* is a brilliant marketing masterclass. It leans directly into the chaotic, darkly comedic DNA of the series while building unprecedented hype as the PS5 release window rapidly approaches. The wait is almost over, and the gaming landscape will never be the same.
